one_liner: Turns your notes into flashcards, practice tests and study games
niche: study tool / flashcard and exam prep app
audience: high school and university students (roughly 14-22) cramming for exams, plus teachers who need low-prep classroom activities; US-centric but used worldwide (inferred)
core_pain: sitting with a pile of messy lecture notes and no idea how to turn them into something you can actually revise from, then rewriting flashcards by hand the night before a test
old_way_objects: reading the textbook over and over
scenes: library at 11pm, student with three highlighters and a 40-page lecture PDF, hasn't started revising
bedroom floor the night before an exam, someone hand-writing index cards and running out of time
teacher at their desk on a Sunday evening building a starter activity from scratch for Monday's lesson
proof_points: turns recorded, written or typed notes into study guides, flashcards, practice tests and games
study modes include Flashcards, Learn, Test, Study Guides, Expert Solutions, study groups, learning games, Live
do_not_say: guaranteed grade improvements or 'get an A'
'millions of students' as a hard number unless quoting the site's own wording
anything implying it does your homework or helps you cheat
claims about specific exam boards or official endorsement
cta: sign up for free (or sign up as a teacher)
